The Hub & Pisgah Tavern Wednesday Shop Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Pisgah Forest, NC. It meets every Wednesday; time posted in the shop's Strava club, starting at The Hub & Pisgah Tavern.

About the The Hub & Pisgah Tavern Wednesday Shop Ride group ride

No-drop Wednesday mountain bike ride into Pisgah from the shop at the forest entrance, with the tavern waiting after. Weekly time and trail are posted in the Strava club.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
